title: Homilies on Numbers, Homily 18
blurb: Origen’s Homily 18 on Numbers (Rufinus’s Latin). Complete on this page: §§1–3.
first_english_note: Original English Translation of Origen’s Homily 18 on Numbers — no previous public-domain English (ANF lacks these homilies; Scheck FOTC is copyrighted and was not used as wording). This page is Homily 18 §§1–3 (closeout). The English here is new.

text_history.method: English follows Baehrens, Origenes Werke VII (GCS 30, 1921), Rufinus’s Latin of Homily 18. Scheck FOTC was not used as wording. This page is Homily 18 §§1–3 (closeout).
